{
  "instructions": "# 已审核的 S8 合成销售分析规则
净收入 net_revenue@1，受控别名净销售额，是订单实付减累计已记录退款，人民币元，不是 finance_revenue_entries 的财务确认收入。没有规则时不能凭表名确认指标口径。
sales_orders 每行一订单，order_id 全局唯一；退款先按 dept_id、order_id 聚合，再 LEFT JOIN 订单；不得直接 JOIN 多笔退款或 order_lines 后重复累计实付。无退款为零。
客户身份必须由 dept_id、customer_id 两列确定，不能单用 customer_id；缺失客户保留订单，行业归为“未知行业”。
当前行业来自 crm_customers；下单时行业来自 crm_industry_history，按同一客户身份并使用 order_date >= valid_from AND order_date < valid_to。有效期重叠必须拒绝发布；没有匹配时保留订单归为未知行业。
客户标签 crm_customer_tags 是允许重叠的多对多关系；先得到一行一订单净额，再关联标签。无标签保留为“无标签”。每组统计其成员订单完整净额，不分摊；不同标签组不能相加作为总净收入，另查去重前基础订单净额。
业务日期 Asia/Shanghai，退款归属原订单日，显式 DATE 边界起含止不含。这里只是合成实验，未实现部门授权。其他目录模型是上下文噪声，不是已审核的销售事实，不替换 sales_orders/销售退款关系。",
  "used_legacy": false
}

WITH refunds AS (SELECT dept_id, order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount FROM sales_refunds GROUP BY dept_id, order_id), base_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.dept_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.paid_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_amount FROM sales_orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.dept_id = r.dept_id AND o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'), industry_groups AS (SELECT COALESCE(h.industry, '未知行业') AS industry, SUM(b.net_amount) AS amount FROM base_orders b LEFT JOIN crm_industry_history h ON b.dept_id = h.dept_id AND b.customer_id = h.customer_id AND b.order_date >= h.valid_from AND b.order_date < h.valid_to GROUP BY COALESCE(h.industry, '未知行业')) SELECT 'group' AS row_type, industry AS label, amount FROM industry_groups UNION ALL SELECT 'total' AS row_type, '不重复总额' AS label, SUM(net_amount) AS amount FROM base_orders
